name: AbraSilver Resource Corp.
description: AbraSilver Resource Corp. is an advanced-stage silver-gold developer focused on its 100%-owned Diablillos project in the Puna region of Salta Province, Argentina. The project hosts a Measured and Indicated resource of approximately 199 million ounces of silver and 1.7 million ounces of gold within 103.9 million tonnes. The company has received environmental approval from Salta authorities and is advancing Diablillos under Argentina's Large Investment (RIGI) program toward a production decision.
